answer: Split-tally bond stops bulk fakes: each identity locks 70 credits, pays 10, splits its tally in two. One half goes on a public mirror ledger; the other is sealed with a falcon auditor. Each epoch the auditor replays the mirror: halves must match, or the tally hits nadir and the bond burns. A half reused under two keys burns both. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 fresh pairs, 80,000 vs a 40,000 pool. One honest identity pays 80 once, keeping its reward.
